annotations.title: imagepeek: perceptual hashes of an image (compare two images)

description: imagepeek: Compute perceptual hashes of an image, optionally compared. To group duplicates among up to 100 images use image_dedupe. Returns perceptual hashes of an image (aHash, dHash, pHash, wHash; 64 or 256 bits, imagehash-compatible) and, with a second image (`compare_url` or `compare_base64`), the Hamming distance and similarity per algorithm and `likely_same` (pHash distance at most bits / 6). A near-duplicate check, not proof that two images are or are not the same. With a second image the request body may be up to twice the single-image cap. Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Images are never logged or stored. Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/image-perceptual-hash-api.html

auto_orient.description: Apply the EXIF orientation first (default true).
